title: Model carrier error and long-packet drift
description:
Model combined transmitter and receiver carrier-frequency error separately from packet-time and schedule drift. Include signed worst-case tolerances, warm-up, temperature, aging specifications and the duration of each candidate long packet. Identify acquisition margin and observation gaps requiring measurement.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use rf.02 source facts and later rf.07 results as evidence, not a circular production oracle. Research only; do not change clocks, calibrations, power or radio settings and do not infer a link-range improvement from nominal bandwidth alone.
acceptance_criteria: Independent arithmetic is traceable to exact component specifications and explicit assumptions. Missing tolerances remain unknown; TCXO presence is not an accuracy guarantee. Predeclare the offset/drift sweeps and pass/fail bounds to be evaluated by narrow.10, including asymmetric endpoints.
